signals.derivation: Prisma schema contains Account, Transaction, Order, Portfolio models -- financial transaction data is processed and stored. Regulatory scope: GDPR and MiFID II.

MiFID II requires 5-year retention of transaction records; GDPR Art. 17 grants right to erasure. Conflict: financial records cannot be fully deleted within retention window. Anonymisation strategy required.
Broker credential storage (Schwab, IBKR) not confirmed in Prisma schema. Access model present but active broker integration unconfirmed. Workshop open item.

JWT_SECRET_KEY and ACCESS_TOKEN_SALT are managed via environment variables (.env.example). Secrets are not hard-coded. Pattern is acceptable but KMS-backed key management is recommended for DORA compliance.
GDPR Art. 17 right to erasure is implemented: DELETE /user and DELETE /user/:id endpoints confirmed in user.controller.ts. Both authenticated with JWT guard.
